scientific_integrity: The unrestricted theorem is supported by an explicit all-order run decomposition and a probabilistic longest-run argument. Exhaustive checks for n=3..13 are corroboration, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Applies to connected unlabeled simple threshold graphs of order at least three, not all chordal graphs or labeled threshold graphs. The historical-priority search may omit unindexed older work. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sibling–tuft asymmetry in connected threshold graphs: exact joint enumeration and limiting separation
